duplicated_metrics.detail: The B2 evaluator computes candidate_recall@10 and hit_rate@10 with the same computation; they are semantically identical and must not be cited as two independent signals.

missing_metrics.detail: Pool recall at larger cutoffs (@20/@50/@100/@200) was never measured, so retrieval headroom is invisible.

non_exclusive_failure_attribution.detail: Retrieval failure (target absent from candidate pool) and ranking failure (target pooled but ranked poorly) are not mutually exclusive in the B2 diagnosis; a pooled-but-misranked target can be counted in both buckets.
